text: Contacts now save as your own filtered views, with a column picker on the list.
Agents & commissions live on the transaction — pick the entity, the split, and the note in one place.
Transactions split by side: the fields, dates, and money you see now match whether you're on the buy or sell side of the file.
The transactions list is a real filterable grid now, with its own creation page and address lookup built in.
Forms route themselves to the right menu, and a contract you upload gets read automatically.
Clients can leave a review of the file and their coordinator once it closes.
